ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 12:1 ratio of low-intensity dark pigmentation pixels (estimated 92% of surface area) to high-intensity white scar/mottling pixels (estimated 8% of surface area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) contiguous area across primary lobe surfaces; localized high-contrast (white) circular clusters on the distal lateral margins; sparse white focal spots across the medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression estimated at 38 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, with a pixel-depth extending approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along both lobes; a prominent macro-indentation (valley) is visible on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 60% distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward curve on lateral edges terminating in sharp, high-intensity distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups on the distal tips of both lobes; a specific cluster of approximately 12 distinct rosettes on the far right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel diagonal white linear marks on the mid-left lobe; multiple intersecting curved white linear marks on the mid-right lobe (rake mark pattern).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of calcified high-contrast material (likely barnacle colonization) on the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edges; distinct rake marks visible on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a bulbous, irregular silhouette due to heavy white pixel-density protrusion compared to the left tip.
